title: Women's Dance Mom – Bun Tight, Wallet Empty Crewneck Sweatshirt

seo.title: Dance Mom Sweatshirt – Bun Tight, Wallet Empty
seo.description: A funny dance mom sweatshirt: a calm woman with a garment bag, hairspray and bobby pins, BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON. WALLET EMPTY. Crewneck, S–3XL.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON. WALLET EMPTY. A dance mom sweatshirt for competition weekends in a cold auditorium, said straight: bun sprayed, smile on, bank account drained by costumes and entry fees.

A calm woman in a track jacket and slim pants walks briskly with a long garment bag over her shoulder, a small rolling makeup case with pink ballet slippers hanging from its handle, a can of hairspray and a few bobby pins in her hand, drawn in dusty rose, deep plum and cream with worn edges. BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON. runs across the top in two lines of dusty-rose capitals on Sand and pale-rose capitals on Maroon, and WALLET EMPTY. runs across the bottom in deep plum on Sand and cream on Maroon.

Wear it to the hotel ballroom hallway, the cold auditorium seat or the long drive home, or give it to the grandma in the bleachers and the studio parents' group. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL (Maroon S–2XL)
  • 2 colors: Sand, Maroon

Questions

How does the Bun Tight, Wallet Empty crewneck fit?
This classic unisex Gildan 18000 crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or size down one for a closer look; go up one for a roomy, cozy layer over a long-sleeve tee. If the size is off, we offer one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

How warm is it and what is it made of?
The Bun Tight, Wallet Empty crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband and no hood. It is a mid-weight, warm layer for a chilly auditorium. Machine wash cold inside out and tumble dry low.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in Sand in sizes S through 3XL and Maroon in sizes S through 2XL. On Sand the top lines are dusty rose and WALLET EMPTY. deep plum; on Maroon they turn pale rose and cream so every word stays clear. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order, and a misprint is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.

Is this dance mom sweatshirt a good gift?
Yes. It is a funny gift for another dance mom, a grandma or the studio parents' group, for a birthday or Christmas. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order in sizes S through 3XL, orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange within 30 days covers the recipient.

When should I order it for a competition or Christmas?
Graphic Tees Co. prints each Bun Tight, Wallet Empty crewneck to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. For a Christmas gift, order by about December 8 so it arrives with time to spare. A misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
